newsitem.title: USA: Poppe Tyson sets 3 mln shr initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: Poppe Tyson sets 3 mln shr initial public offering.

text.p: Poppe Tyson Inc said Friday that it plans to sell up to three million common shares in its initial public offering.
The company, in an amended filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission said the offering is estimated to be priced between $10 and $12 per share.
The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 450,000 additional shares. The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co and Dean Witter Reynolds Inc.
The company said after the offering there will be 10,288,700 common shares outstanding.
Poppe Tyson's stock will be listed on Nasdaq under the symbol "POPT"
Proceeds will be used for repayment of intercorporate borrowings to BJK&E, its parent company Bozell, Jacobs, Kenyon & Eckhardt Inc, the company said.

Proceeds will also be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital and funding for the continued development of the company's interactive marketing communications business, among others, it said.
